name: IKS Bulwark
_comment: R3.76, Module R3 SSD book page 30. Corner YS:176 DK:7 EX:18 CR:8; annex crew 40 and 10
boarding parties; POINT VALUE a single 119, and the data table adds 'INCLUDES FULL AEGIS'.
A D6 hull turned into an escort, and the conversion is drastic: THE DISRUPTORS ARE GONE.
Where the D6 mounts four, this ship carries phaser-2s in their place beside both warp
engines — 8 and 9 to port, 10 and 11 to starboard — for eleven phaser-2s in all and no heavy
weapon of any kind. Two ADDs and two drone racks do the rest. That is what makes it an escort
rather than a cruiser that happens to escort.
It services someone else's air group and has none of its own. The sheet: 'AS A CARRIER
ESCORT, THIS SHIP HAS DECK CREWS AND READY RACKS TO SERVICE THE FIGHTERS OF THE CARRIER. IT
HAS NO FIGHTERS OF ITS OWN.' So the bay below declares fighterFacilities and a LINE with no
counts, which is the same shape the AD5, F5E and D5E already use (J4.62).
'RACKS ALWAYS HAD THREE RELOADS. THIRD RELOAD IS ENTIRELY ADDS.' A type-G rack carries two
by default, so the third is the extra reload set that y175Upgrades already expresses — and
since this ship cannot exist before Y176 it has that reload from the moment it is built, which
is what 'always' means here. The third reload being ADDs specifically is NOT modelled; our
reload sets do not distinguish their contents.
controlMod 2.0 from the sheet's own note, the same doubled seeking-weapon control the D7V and
D5N carry. Anti-drones always had 12 rounds, hence ADD_12.
INHERITED, not counted: transporters, tractors and labs are the D6's. The hull boxes that
were read directly are the ones the conversion touched.
_refitComment: One refit on the data table: K REFIT (Y175) = +3. The sheet names what it touches —
'PHASER-2s MARKED K ARE CHANGED TO PHASER-1s ON THE K REFIT' — and the marked ones are the
three forward. There is no B refit and no UIM refit offered.
